# AI Community Intertidal Clean up

Group Questions: Species occurrence: For a selected taxon or group, where and when was it recorded? Make an occurrence or detection-frequency summary, explicitly distinguishing absence from not surveyed and accounting for sampling effort.

# Cleaning Data

## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(stringr)
library(maps)
library(mapdata)
library(mapproj)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(maptiles)
library(tidyterra)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(ggspatial)
library(leafpop)
```

## Load Data

Read in all of the data

```{r}
master <- read_csv("AI_data/Data/Processed/opihi_master.csv")
algae_review <- read_csv("AI_data/Data/Algae/algae_origin_review.csv")
raw <- read_csv("AI_data/Data/Processed/opihi_master.csv",show_col_types = FALSE)
lookup <- read_csv("AI_data/Data/Algae/algae_origin_lookup.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(taxon_clean, origin_status)

```


Organizing data:

```{r}
algae <- raw |>
  filter(category == "Algae", island=="Oahu") |>
  left_join(lookup, by = "taxon_clean") |>
  mutate(origin_group = case_when(
    origin_status %in% c("Native", "Native (likely)")             ~ "Native",
    origin_status %in% c("Non-native", "Non-native (invasive)")   ~ "Non-native",
    TRUE ~ "Unresolved"   # cryptogenic, genus-level, turf, unknown groups
  ))
```
## AI Conversations

Differentiating native algae from invasive algae. When asking AI (Claude) to clean the master sheet and create new sheets only displaying algae data, I mentioned that I planned to differentiate native and non-native limu. Claude did this on itʻs own, with itʻs own sources and created a new data sheet with the algae species organized as either "Native", "Non-native(Invasive)", or "Unresolved." As seen in conversation and data below:

**ME**: I can first make a new data sheet that only has algae. Then I can plot and interactive map that shows where the native vs non-native algae was found around the island. Secondly, I want to make a plot showing the abundance of native vs non-native species on a time series line graph for each location. So it would be two lines and I would change out the location for each, resulting in around 8 graphs?

**CLAUDE**: I wrote algae_map_and_timeseries.R, which covers all three steps. I haven’t run it, since R isn’t available in my sandbox, so expect to fix a small thing or two on the first run.
What the script does
1. Algae-only sheet. It writes algae_only.csv, with each record labeled Native, Non-native, or Unresolved. It also writes a companion quadrat_samples.csv listing every quadrat surveyed, including ones with no algae. Without that second file, empty quadrats disappear from an algae-only sheet and average cover comes out too high.
2. Interactive map. Each location gets a green circle for native algae and a red circle for non-native algae, sized by mean % cover. The circles are offset a few hundred meters east and west so both stay visible, and you can toggle each layer. Clicking a site shows its cover values, number of quadrats, and survey years. The map is saved as oahu_native_vs_nonnative_map.html.
3. Time series. There are two lines per location, native and non-native. plot_site("Leahi") draws one site, and changing the name switches locations. The script also saves a PNG for each site and one overview page with all of them.

I made a review sheet and a script that merges your decisions back, so you don’t have to edit the lookup by hand. I haven’t run the R script.
How to clean it up
1. Open algae_origin_review.csv. It lists 109 taxa, with the ones that most need a decision first. The first 30 rows are the “check” taxa, such as Turbinaria ornata, Spyridia filamentosa, and Colpomenia sinuosa, followed by the 46 genus-level entries, then my 29 “likely native” and 4 non-native calls to confirm.
2. Fill in your_status using only Native, Non-native, Cryptogenic, or Unresolved. Put your source in source_or_note. Leave a row blank to keep the current status.
3. Run update_origin_lookup.R. It checks that your entries are valid, writes an updated algae_origin_lookup.csv, keeps a backup of the old one, and prints what’s still undecided.
Re-run algae_map_and_timeseries.R. I updated it to accept the new labels, and the map and graphs will pick up your changes. Cryptogenic and Unresolved taxa are left off the native and non-native lines.
4. Where to look things up
* UH Reefalgae field guide (hawaii.edu/reefalgae), which marks algae as alien, native, or unknown origin.
* AlgaeBase, filtered to the Hawaiian Islands.
* Carlton & Eldredge (2009), the Bishop Museum list of introduced and cryptogenic marine species in Hawaiʻi.
* A local expert. Your organization may already have someone who can confirm the less certain taxa.


*All of the algae from these data sheets were cross checked with the book ʻHawaiian Reef Plantsʻ as well as Algae Base.*

```{r}
#| label: fig-sample_sites
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: Oʻahu algae sampling locations.

leaflet(oahu_geocoded) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) |>
```

```{r}
# Every quadrat surveyed on Oahu (so quadrats with no algae count as 0)
samples <- raw |>
  filter(sample_type == "quadrat", island == "Oahu") |>
  distinct(sample_id, site_name, year, lat = latitude, lon = longitude, points_possible)

# Algae points per quadrat
algae_pts <- raw |>
  filter(category == "Algae", sample_type == "quadrat") |>
  group_by(sample_id) |>
  summarise(points = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Mean % cover per site
site_algae <- samples |>
  left_join(algae_pts, by = "sample_id") |>
  mutate(cover = pmin(100 * replace_na(points, 0) / points_possible, 100)) |>
  group_by(site_name, lat, lon) |>
  summarise(mean_cover = mean(cover), n_quadrats = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Algae points per quadrat, split into native vs non-native
group_pts <- raw |>
  filter(category == "Algae", sample_type == "quadrat") |>
  left_join(lookup, by = "taxon_clean") |>
  mutate(origin_group = case_when(
    origin_status %in% c("Native", "Native (likely)")           ~ "Native",
    origin_status %in% c("Non-native", "Non-native (invasive)") ~ "Non-native",
    TRUE ~ "Unresolved")) |>
  filter(origin_group %in% c("Native", "Non-native")) |>
  group_by(sample_id, origin_group) |>
  summarise(points = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

quad <- samples |>
  crossing(origin_group = c("Native", "Non-native")) |>
  left_join(group_pts, by = c("sample_id", "origin_group")) |>
  mutate(cover = pmin(100 * replace_na(points, 0) / points_possible, 100))

# Site level (map circles) and site x year level (popup graphs)
site_group <- quad |>
  group_by(site_name, lat, lon, origin_group) |>
  summarise(mean_cover = mean(cover), n_quadrats = n_distinct(sample_id),
            .groups = "drop")

site_year <- quad |>
  group_by(site_name, year, origin_group) |>
  summarise(mean_cover = mean(cover), n_quadrats = n_distinct(sample_id),
            .groups = "drop")

```

### Plotting % Cover of Native vs Non-Native

```{r}
map_cols <- c("Native (likely)"       = "#2ca25f",
              "Non-native (invasive)" = "#e34a33")

popup_tbl <- quad |>
  group_by(site_name, origin_group) |>
  summarise(mean_cover = mean(cover), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = origin_group, values_from = mean_cover) |>
  rename(native_cover = Native, nonnative_cover = `Non-native`)

site_info <- quad |>
  group_by(site_name) |>
  summarise(n_quadrats = n_distinct(sample_id),
            first_year = min(year), last_year = max(year),
            n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop")

site_map <- site_group |>
  select(-n_quadrats) |>                      # avoid the duplicate column name
  left_join(popup_tbl, by = "site_name") |>
  left_join(site_info, by = "site_name") |>
  mutate(popup = paste0("<b>", site_name, "</b><br>",
                        "Native: ", round(native_cover, 1), "% cover<br>",
                        "Non-native: ", round(nonnative_cover, 1), "% cover<br>",
                        "Quadrats: ", n_quadrats, "<br>",
                        "Survey years: ", n_years, " (", first_year, "-", last_year, ")"))

native_pts <- site_map |> filter(origin_group == "Native")
nonnat_pts <- site_map |> filter(origin_group == "Non-native")

offset_deg <- 0.0035   # nudges the two circles ~400 m apart; set to 0 to stack them
max_cover <- max(site_map$mean_cover, na.rm = TRUE)   # largest circle = highest cover
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-invasive-native
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: Mean percent cover of Native and Non-native algae across Oʻahu sampling locations.

leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = native_pts, lng = ~lon - offset_deg, lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~4 + 14 * sqrt(mean_cover / max_cover),
    fillColor = map_cols[["Native (likely)"]], fillOpacity = 0.85,
    color = "white", weight = 1,
    label = ~paste0(site_name, " - native: ", round(mean_cover, 1), "% cover"),
    popup = ~popup, group = "Native") |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = nonnat_pts, lng = ~lon + offset_deg, lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~4 + 14 * sqrt(mean_cover / max_cover),
    fillColor = map_cols[["Non-native (invasive)"]], fillOpacity = 0.85,
    color = "white", weight = 1,
    label = ~paste0(site_name, " - non-native: ", round(mean_cover, 1), "% cover"),
    popup = ~popup, group = "Non-native") |>
  addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Native", "Non-native"),
                   options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) |>
  addLegend("bottomright",
            colors = unname(map_cols), labels = names(map_cols),
            title = "Mean % cover<br>(all years)", opacity = 1) |>
  fitBounds(-158.30, 21.25, -157.62, 21.72)
```

### Plotting Total % Algae cover

```{r}
#| label: fig-percent-cover
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: Mean percent cover of total algae across Oʻahu sampling locations.

pal <- colorNumeric("YlGn", site_algae$mean_cover)

leaflet(site_algae) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~4 + 14 * sqrt(mean_cover / max(mean_cover)),   # bigger = more algae
    fillColor = ~pal(mean_cover), fillOpacity = 0.9,
    color = "white", weight = 1,
    label = ~paste0(site_name, ": ", round(mean_cover, 1), "% algae cover"),
    popup = ~paste0("<b>", site_name, "</b><br>Mean cover: ",
                    round(mean_cover, 1), "%<br>Quadrats: ", n_quadrats)) |>
  addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~mean_cover,
            title = "Mean % algae cover") |>
  fitBounds(-158.30, 21.25, -157.62, 21.72)   # whole island
```


```{r}
# ----  TIME SERIES: NATIVE vs NON-NATIVE, ONE GRAPH PER SITE ------------------
site_year <- quad |>
  group_by(site_name, year, origin_group) |>
  summarise(n_quadrats = n_distinct(sample_id),
            mean_cover = mean(cover),
            se = sd(cover) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# Only sites with enough survey years for a line to mean anything
min_years <- 3
sites_to_plot <- site_year |>
  group_by(site_name) |>
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_years >= min_years) |>
  pull(site_name)
sites_to_plot

cols <- c("Native" = "#2ca25f", "Non-native" = "#e34a33")

## Plot function for each individual site

plot_site <- function(site) {
  site_year |>
    filter(site_name == site) |> # site is the variable that changes
    ggplot(aes(year, mean_cover, color = origin_group)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, name = NULL) +
    labs(title = site, x = "Year", y = "Mean % Cover Per Quadrat", size=NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-leahi
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: Percent algal cover per quadrat at Leahi sampling location from 2005 to 2025.

# View a single site (swap the name to change locations)
plot_site("Leahi")

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mauliola
#| echo: true
```
